title: Fourier weight at a fixed level
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and let $k$ be a natural number. Its Fourier weight at level $k$ is the sum of the Fourier weights over all subsets of the coordinate set having cardinality exactly $k$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
